mapper.insert: INSERT INTO investment_cash_balance (account_id, user_id, currency, amount, cny_rate, cny_amount, note) VALUES (#{accountId}, #{userId}, #{currency}, #{amount}, #{cnyRate}, #{cnyAmount}, #{note})
mapper.update: UPDATE investment_cash_balance SET amount = #{amount}, cny_rate = #{cnyRate}, cny_amount = #{cnyAmount}, note = #{note}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM investment_cash_balance WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
